newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MAD DAD SENDS ITALIAN REFEREE RUNNING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MAD DAD SENDS ITALIAN REFEREE RUNNING.

text.p: An Italian referee suspended a juvenile match and sought sanctuary in the changing rooms to escape a player's irate father who invaded the pitch and headed threateningly in his direction.

The news agency Ansa reported on Thursday that the referee at a youth championship match between 14 and 15 year olds blew his whistle and fled after just 17 minutes with the visiting team of Casei Gerola 1-0 up on Borgonovo Val Tidone.
The father of one of the Borgonovo players had begun shouting abuse after the goal was awarded and could not contain himself when a Borgonovo player was booked.
